findings.finding: Receiver pose6_codes are ordinal rank codes and cannot be inserted into the metric G1 homography.
findings.fix: Use SHA-bound target-cache metric Pose6; mark cross-pair transport mismatch and non-free side information; keep physical BEV null.

findings.finding: NumPy 2.4 Accelerate small-matrix matmul reported invalid floating-point flags on finite inputs.
findings.fix: Use explicit deterministic scalar ufunc products with finite checks and raise-on-overflow.

findings.finding: A stale 03_outputs_complete checkpoint from a prior rerun could enter the new receipt and then be overwritten, breaking resume custody.
findings.fix: Exclude the final marker from scientific receipt inputs; validate outputs, compact outputs, and source files on resume.

findings.finding: The old #141 margin-saliency measurement is vehicle-relative to bc20 and no current v12 predictor-margin tensor is retained.
findings.fix: Report aggregate-pixel context separately; label boundary-distance as a topology proxy and require current predictor-margin custody before a margin-context claim.
